Greedent

Normal

Galar · Generation 8

Greedent is a Normal-type Greedy Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 6 kg. It evolves from Skwovet. Its highest base stat is HP (120), with a base stat total of 460.
